custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location, with 4 on hand, and at location B under the same part number.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test at the test location, purchase order 1, from any vendor, with a line for part A picked from the lookup, 2 ordered and none received.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test at location B, purchase order 2, from any vendor, with a line for part A picked from the lookup, 4 ordered and none received.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425696 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425696-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  2. Switch to location B: Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  3. Make part A at location B: At location B, make part A again with the same Part Number, the same way.
  4. Make the purchase order: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick any Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425696-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list. Type 2 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive.
  5. Switch to location B: Switch to Staging Lethbridge - 4310 as above.
  6. Make the purchase order: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick any Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425696-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list. Type 4 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive.
